title: Open-Source GIS Architecture & Multicriteria Software Benchmarking
author: GIS Geography / Antigravity Cognitive Distillation

claims.assertion: Whitebox GAT succeeded Terrain Analysis System (TAS) for hydro-geomorphic DEM applications and is the leading free LiDAR tool with 410+ tools and native LAS-to-shapefile extraction.
GRASS GIS is trusted by NASA, NOAA, USDA, and USGS for land management, image classification, and digital terrain manipulation with over 350 rock-solid tools.
SAGA GIS's Topographic Wetness Index (TWI) and Topographic Position Classification make it the definitive engine for raster DEM morphometry and closing data gaps.
GeoDa is the standard academic spatial statistics gateway (Harvard, MIT, Cornell) covering Moran's I, LISA clusters, and spatial lag/error regression.
MapWindow 5 bundles TauDEM for automatic watershed delineation and HydroDesktop under a US EPA 'Basins' open-source contract.
gvSIG Mobile enables GPS field data collection with OpenCAD vertex snapping, geometry splitting, and NavTable vertical record navigation.
Diva GIS specializes in biological richness and diversity distribution including DNA marker data and WorldClim climate extractions.
FalconView was developed by Georgia Tech for the US Department of Defense and National Geospatial-Intelligence Agencies for combat flight planning and is defense-restricted.
